title: Lagos 2026 Anniversary Hangout
subtitle: Worship, Word, prayer, connections, and joyful fellowship.
description: Join us for our Lagos 2026 Anniversary Hangout! A power-packed day of worship, bible study, prayer, connections, open conversations, and games.
fullDescription:
Join us for our Lagos 2026 Anniversary Hangout at Ndubuisi Kanu Park, Ikeja, Lagos!

A celebration of God's goodness, revival, and community. We are gathering for unhindered worship, deep bible study, earnest prayer, meaningful connections, open real conversations, and fun games.

Come expectant, invite a friend, and let's make unforgettable memories together in Christ.
